text:
tia_billing: FYI  Acquirer opened a dispute on invoice INV-119877 (cardholder says they were charged the wrong amount after a plan renewal). They labeled it 'incorrect_amount'. Need an evidence packet.

billing-bot: Alert: DISPUTE_OPEN dispute_id=dp_X1z2 amount=720.00 currency=USD reason=incorrect_amount open_ts=1968999900

lee_support: Ticket #7555 shows the customer reported being billed full price instead of the prorated renewal price after applying promo PR-MAR. Agent confirmed promo was applied at purchase but shows renewal invoice without credit. I can attach the transcript and agent notes.

own_fraud: Quick checks: gateway shows single capture for $720.00; billing system recorded a $-120.00 credit that did not apply due to billing cycle edge case. No signs of fraud. Recommend we include: invoice PDF, billing ledger CSV, promo application logs, gateway receipt, and support transcript.

pat_ops: I pulled billing ledger and promo audit: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-119877/billing_ledger_INV-119877.csv and s3://redwood-disputes/INV-119877/promo_audit_PR-MAR.log. Looks like the credit was issued as a separate adjustment which didn't attach to the captured transaction. I'll also include the retry/dunning logs.

tia_billing: Core txn details for packet:

```
Invoice: INV-119877
Customer: BrightLayer Ltd (acct bl-4450)
Amount captured: $720.00
Expected after promo: $600.00
Adjustment issued: -$120.00 (adj_3398)
Charge ID: ch_Qs7mL
Gateway auth: 330118
Acquirer reason: incorrect_amount
```

sara_legal: For billing disputes we need: invoice, capture receipt, adjustment/credit memo, support transcript, promo terms screenshot, and a short factual narrative of what happened. Also include any automated emails sent to the customer about the adjustment. Redact any PII in transcripts.

lee_support: Pasting redacted ticket excerpt: > customer: "I was charged $720 but should've been charged $600 with my promo." > agent: "We issued a $120 adjustment on 2026-03-28; refund/credit posted to your account. Banking refund may take 5-7 business days."

own_fraud: I'll prepare a brief timeline: original renewal billed at 2026-03-28T08:12Z, adjustment issued 2026-03-28T09:03Z, no duplicate capture, ledger shows adjustment adj_3398 applied to account balance but not captured txn. Include promolog and billing rule that caused mis-association.

pat_ops: Uploaded files to disputes bucket and the disputes dashboard: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-119877/{billing_ledger_INV-119877.csv,promo_audit_PR-MAR.log,adjustment_adj_3398.pdf}. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-119877

billing-bot: Reminder: evidence window for incorrect_amount disputes = 5 business days. Time left ~4d 20h.

tia_billing: Checklist before submit: [x] invoice PDF, [x] gateway receipt, [x] billing ledger, [x] promo audit log, [x] adjustment memo, [x] support transcript (redacted), [ ] narrative (drafted). ETA 60m. :hourglass:

sara_legal: Once narrative is drafted I'll review for neutral language. If acquirer asks for settlement batch, we'll provide that too.

own_fraud: Drafted narrative and uploaded to dashboard. Language factual, includes timestamps and IDs.

pat_ops: Confirmed uploaded settlement batch snippet: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-119877/settlement_batch_20260328.csv

lee_support: Submitted evidence to disputes dashboard and noted customer was proactively credited. Ticket #7555 updated.

billing-bot: Evidence submitted for dp_X1z2 status=evidence_uploaded timestamp=1969000158

sara_legal: Reviewing now. Quick nit: remove language like "system bug"; state "billing rule mis-association". Otherwise looks good.

tia_billing: Made wording change and submitted final. Tagging @sara_legal and @owen_fraud for final ack.

owen_fraud: Ack. Good packet. Will watch for acquirer follow-up.

tia_billing: Thanks team. If acquirer pushes for refund proof we'll attach bank-level refund trace. :white_check_mark:
